findings.text: non-blocking: the gate paragraphs name head 004d9f1e5 while the reviewed head is fca9b022f; the intervening commit changes only this file, so no test outcome can differ, but a reader comparing the receipt's revision against the promoted commit sees a mismatch.

non-blocking: Path(module_path).read_text() takes the locale encoding while every module under tests/graph, conftest.py included, is UTF-8; under a non-UTF-8 locale it raises UnicodeDecodeError, which the surrounding except clause does not catch, so collection would crash instead of refusing — pass encoding="utf-8" as tests/standard_names/source_scan.py:46 does.

item_verdicts.call_sites: none: the change is test collection infrastructure; pytest's collector invokes tests/graph/conftest.py:pytest_collection_modifyitems on every run under tests/graph/, and no module under imas_codex/ imports tests/conftest or the guard.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from aecc88921 to fca9b022f: 004d9f1e5 adds same-file helper following plus eight guard tests, fca9b022f rewrites only the evidence fragment, and no file outside the three named paths is touched (+213/-12).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for both gate arms, zero added failure ids and logged controls; logs/base-graph.log and logs/head-graph.log each open with their revision and literal command and end in a bare EXIT=1, and logs/base-graph.ids and logs/head-graph.ids compare as identical sorted 18-id sets, so added and removed are both 0.
item_verdicts.goal: the source node's goal is to route the five graph-marked writers in tests/graph onto a disposable Neo4j and keep the hazard from returning; the two gained commits extend the guard at tests/graph/conftest.py:380 and cover its decisions at tests/graph/test_graph_writer_guard.py:90-131 without altering that routing.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the reviewed run directory; status reads complete and it lists the five commits ending fca9b022f, both gate arms with their log paths, the writers probe at EXIT=0, the negative control naming the project URI, and the retry its project-graph outage caused.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are tests/graph/conftest.py, the two writer test files, tests/conftest.py only if the shared fixture moved, and the evidence fragment; the gained diff touches tests/graph/conftest.py, tests/graph/test_graph_writer_guard.py and the fragment, and leaves tests/conftest.py untouched.

justifications.durability: each test at tests/graph/test_graph_writer_guard.py:90-131 names a condition that reddens it — dropping the same-file branch at tests/graph/conftest.py:412 leaves the delegating writer reading writes=False and fails :95, and rescanning every string constant fails :109 — though the recursion bound at :383 and the empty-module fallback at :419 carry no test.
justifications.evidence: logs/base-graph.log and logs/head-graph.log each carry a revision-and-command header and a bare EXIT=1 over identical 18-id failure sets, and I re-ran tests/graph/test_graph_writer_guard.py at fca9b022f in a scratch tree (8 passed); but both arms were made at 004d9f1e5 and the base arm deselects the five writers, so neither arm is the reviewed head nor the same test set.
justifications.fit: the added helpers follow the mechanism-comment style of the guard they extend at tests/graph/conftest.py:363-440 and carry no plan, ticket or author identifiers, but :469 calls read_text() with no encoding where the sibling scanner tests/standard_names/source_scan.py:46 names utf-8.
justifications.goal_fidelity: tests/graph/conftest.py:380 _scan_calls follows a call to a same-file helper, so the delegating writer the previous review found escaping now reads writes=True and is refused, and nothing else about the node's routing changes.
justifications.reuse: a search of tests/ and imas_codex/ for an existing same-file call follower or a shared fake-item helper found none — tests/test_environment_precedence.py:10 _collected_item is a Mock-based helper local to its file with no shared owner — so _module_functions and _scan_calls extend the existing guard rather than fork an owned capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the gained diff — tests/graph/conftest.py, tests/graph/test_graph_writer_guard.py and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-graph-dir-writer-routing.html — is inside the manifest's declared write paths.
